title: bromus macranthos var. minor
intro: Bromus macranthos var. minor, commonly known as Broom Brome, is a plant species in the grass family. It is a perennial grass native to Europe and Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Broom Brome include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and treating infections. The therapeutic actions of Broom Brome include its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
